name: Box
outlook:
What Box says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: revenueRevenue is expected to be approximately $329 million, up 9% year-over-year, or 11% on a constant currency basis. This includes an expected headwind of approximately 170 basis points due to FX.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: operating marginGAAP operating margin is expected to be approximately 10.0% and non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be approximately 28.0%. This includes an expected headwind of approximately 80 basis points due to FX.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: non-GAAP earnings per shareNon-GAAP diluted net income per share attributable to common stockholders is expected to be approximately $0.39. This includes an expected headwind of approximately $0.02 due to FX.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: revenueRevenue is expected to be approximately $1.290 billion, up 10% year-over-year, or 11% on a constant currency basis. This includes an expected headwind of approximately 100 basis points due to FX.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 25, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
